name: HashiCorp Packer
role_in_genoa: None — disqualified. Industry-standard image builder; genoa is the BSD-native replacement in this niche.

name: mkosi
role_in_genoa: None — disqualified for vendoring. Can be invoked externally for Linux-base genoa targets. Systemd-ecosystem, Linux-only.

name: osbuild
role_in_genoa: Red Hat's image pipeline engine; genoa Option B substrate. Not used in Option A (FreeBSD/NetBSD path). Reference implementation for pipeline-stage model.

name: bootc-image-builder
role_in_genoa: OCI container -> bootable disk image. Relevant if genoa adds a container-in, disk-out pipeline for Linux targets. Not a BSD substrate.

name: bootc
role_in_genoa: Container-native bootable image tool. Potential model for genoa's 'BYOI from OCI' story on Linux. Not BSD-native but architecture is instructive.

name: diskimage-builder (DIB)
role_in_genoa: OpenStack image builder; Linux-only in practice. Element-based plugin model is a good prior art for genoa's plugin architecture. Do not vendor.

name: image-builder (k8s-sigs)
role_in_genoa: Kubernetes cluster node image builder. Packer-based; disqualified for direct use due to Packer dependency. Reference for multi-provider matrix approach.

name: nanobsd
role_in_genoa: FreeBSD base shell scripts for minimal image builds. In-tree in FreeBSD. genoa Option A builds on the same substrate. Understand before reimplementing.

name: makefs
role_in_genoa: FreeBSD/NetBSD tool to create filesystem images without root. Core primitive for genoa Option A. Already in FreeBSD base — invoke, don't reimplement.

name: mkimg
role_in_genoa: FreeBSD tool to create disk images with partition tables. Core primitive for genoa Option A. Invoke as external command.

name: Yocto / OpenEmbedded
role_in_genoa: Embedded Linux distro builder. Linux-only, no BSD support. GPL toolchain disqualifies for vendoring. Mention as prior art only.

name: Alpine mkimage / apkbuild
role_in_genoa: Alpine Linux image creation scripts. Relevant if genoa supports Alpine as a base. apk package model is a reference for minimal image design.

name: NixOS nix-build (VM images)
role_in_genoa: Nix itself is LGPL — disqualified for vendoring. NixOS VM image generation is technically excellent reference architecture. nixpkgs (MIT) could theoretically be used without nix binary.

name: HashiCorp Vagrant
role_in_genoa: None — BUSL disqualifies vendoring (same pattern as Packer). Vagrant box format is relevant for genoa local-test output target.

name: bsdec2-image-upload
role_in_genoa: PURPOSE-BUILT FreeBSD AMI registration tool by Colin Percival. C + shell. Handles S3 upload, snapshot conversion, AMI registration. USE AS AWS ADAPTER. Last commit 2026-01.

name: aws ec2 import-image (aws-cli)
role_in_genoa: Generic AWS VM Import. Supports vmdk/raw/ova. Use as fallback when bsdec2-image-upload is not needed (non-FreeBSD images). Invoke via aws-cli subprocess.

name: gcloud compute images import
role_in_genoa: GCP image import CLI. Invoke as external command for GCP target. gcloud SDK is Apache-2.0.

name: daisy (Google)
role_in_genoa: GCP image build-and-import workflow tool. Active (commit 2026-04-30). Could orchestrate multi-step GCP import; genoa can invoke directly or use gcloud wrapper.

name: oci-cli
role_in_genoa: Oracle Cloud CLI. UPL-1.0 is OSI-approved permissive license; Apache-2.0 path available as dual-license. See license-questions.md. Last commit 2026-04-28.

name: vultr-cli
role_in_genoa: Vultr provider CLI. Apache-2.0. Active. Invoke for Vultr upload target.

name: doctl
role_in_genoa: DigitalOcean CLI. Apache-2.0. Active. Invoke for DO custom image upload.

name: linode-cli
role_in_genoa: Linode/Akamai Cloud CLI. BSD-3. Active. Invoke for Linode image upload.

name: hcloud-cli
role_in_genoa: Hetzner Cloud CLI. MIT. Active. Invoke for Hetzner image upload. Note: Hetzner does not support custom OS images the same way; use server snapshots.

name: scaleway-cli (scw)
role_in_genoa: Scaleway CLI. Apache-2.0. Active. Invoke for Scaleway image import.

name: OpenTofu
role_in_genoa: Open-source Terraform fork. MPL-2.0 is copyleft-ish (file-level). Not on genoa's hard-allowed list. See license-questions.md. Would be invoked externally, not vendored.

name: Pulumi
role_in_genoa: IaC platform. Apache-2.0. Could orchestrate multi-cloud image registration workflows. Invoke externally; do not vendor pulumi SDK unless needed.

name: virt-install (libvirt)
role_in_genoa: libvirt VM provisioning. LGPL — no vendoring. Can invoke as external command for local qemu/kvm testing target. Useful for CI integration tests.

name: cloud-init
role_in_genoa: De facto standard first-boot configuration. Ships in guest images; genoa bakes datasource config. Apache-2.0 path exists but GPL-3 files may be present. See license-questions.md.

name: ignition
role_in_genoa: CoreOS-style declarative first-boot tool. Apache-2.0. Genoa could generate ignition configs as an alternative to cloud-init for Fedora CoreOS / Flatcar targets.

name: cloudbase-init
role_in_genoa: Windows guest first-boot equivalent to cloud-init. Apache-2.0. Active. Relevant only if genoa adds Windows image targets.

name: bsdinstall scripts
role_in_genoa: FreeBSD installer scripts. In FreeBSD base. genoa can embed bsdinstall scripts for unattended first-run configuration on bare images. BSD-2.

name: bsd-cloud-image.org
role_in_genoa: Community effort to produce official BSD cloud images. Status: active but low-resource. License unconfirmed from web fetch — site returned minimal content. genoa should align with or contribute to rather than duplicate.

name: FreeBSD release/Makefile.vm
role_in_genoa: Official FreeBSD VM image build targets. genoa Option A is essentially a structured wrapper around this. Read carefully before reimplementing any steps.

name: smolBSD (NetBSDfr)
role_in_genoa: User's local reference implementation. NetBSD microVM builder using makefs+mkimg. Active (2026-04-27). genoa should learn from its minimal-image approach.

name: HardenedBSD cloud images
role_in_genoa: Security-hardened FreeBSD fork. Has /release tooling. Limited cloud image production. Useful as a reference for hardened image builds; not a direct dependency.

name: depenguin-me
role_in_genoa: Trampoline pattern: boots mfsBSD via QEMU inside Linux rescue env to install FreeBSD. MIT license. REJECTED by genoa design — genoa builds native images, not trampolines. Last commit 2026-03.

name: in-toto
role_in_genoa: Supply chain integrity framework. Apache-2.0. Use for build-step attestation — each genoa pipeline stage signs its outputs. Links to SLSA.

name: cosign / sigstore
role_in_genoa: Image and artifact signing. Apache-2.0. Active. Use for signing genoa-produced image manifests and SBOM documents.

name: SLSA framework
license: Apache-2.0 (pre-2023 parts), Community Specification License 1.0 (newer parts)
role_in_genoa: Supply-chain levels specification. Normative target for genoa attestation design. Not a library — adopt SLSA Level 2+ as the compliance target.

name: syft
role_in_genoa: SBOM generator (SPDX/CycloneDX output). Apache-2.0. Active. USE AS SBOM GENERATOR for genoa-produced images. Invoke post-build to enumerate image contents.

name: spdx-tools
role_in_genoa: SPDX document validation and conversion. Apache-2.0. Use to validate syft-produced SPDX output before publishing.

name: guac
role_in_genoa: Graph-based supply chain metadata aggregator. Apache-2.0. Active. Downstream consumer of genoa SBOMs/attestations; not a direct genoa dependency.

name: ollama
role_in_genoa: Local LLM serving. MIT. Active. Candidate for baking into agent-capable genoa images.

name: Caddy
role_in_genoa: Reverse proxy / TLS terminator. Apache-2.0. Active. Good candidate for genoa image service layer — auto-TLS, no external dep.

name: Vector
role_in_genoa: Log/metrics pipeline. MPL-2.0 (copyleft-ish, file-level). Not on hard-allowed list. See license-questions.md. Performance is excellent.

name: Fluent Bit
role_in_genoa: Lightweight log/metrics shipper. Apache-2.0. Active. PREFERRED over Vector for log shipping in genoa images — no license concerns.

name: Datadog Agent
role_in_genoa: Observability agent. Apache-2.0 core. Candidate for baking into fleet-observable genoa images.
